build_task_with_define_task: use the define_task decorator to register a new PHYRE task function with the creator library
create_dynamic_objects_with_add: use C.add to create dynamic objects like jars and balls with a given scale
position_objects_with_setters: chain set_center_x, set_bottom, set_angle, set_right, and set_left to position scene objects
get_phantom_vertices: call get_phantom_vertices on a jar object to retrieve its internal boundary vertices for spatial checks
define_task_goal_with_update_task: use update_task to set body1, body2, spatial relationships, and phantom vertices as the task goal
